tests.name: test_int_float_near_max_int64
tests.intent: Verify exact comparison between large signed integers near 2^63 and floats to check transitiveness.

tests.name: test_unsigned_int_float_boundary
tests.intent: Verify exact comparison of unsigned integers near large boundaries against floating point values.

tests.name: test_nan_operand_behavior
tests.intent: Check that NaN operands mixed with integers result in false for comparisons and maintain unordered state.

tests.name: test_exact_small_integers
tests.intent: Ensure small integer and float representations that are exact remain equal and correctly ordered.

tests.name: test_fractional_float_comparison
tests.intent: Verify behavior when float operand contains a fractional part near integer boundaries.

tests.name: test_float_outside_bound
tests.intent: Check comparisons when the float operand is well outside the range of the integer type's exact bound.

tests.name: test_spaceship_operator_mixed
tests.intent: Exercise three-way comparison operator (<=>) between integers and floats.

tests.name: test_unsigned_negative_float
tests.intent: Probe comparison between unsigned integers and negative floating point numbers.

tests.name: test_float_lhs_integer_rhs
tests.intent: Test comparisons where the float is on the left-hand side and the integer on the right-hand side.

tests.name: test_zero_comparisons
tests.intent: Verify integer zero and float zero equality and relational outcomes.

tests.name: test_large_unsigned_bound
tests.intent: Test unsigned integer comparison right around 2^63 and 2^64 boundaries with floats.

tests.name: test_truncation_exact_range
tests.intent: Check behavior when float values fall directly on integer truncation boundaries.

tests.name: test_inequality_operators
tests.intent: Ensure not-equal (!=), greater-than (>), and greater-or-equal (>=) work correctly with mixed number comparisons.

tests.name: test_negative_integers_float
tests.intent: Check comparison of negative signed integers with various floating point values.

tests.name: test_infinities_mixed
tests.intent: Check behavior of positive and negative infinities compared against integers.

tests.name: test_ordered_json_mixed_compare
tests.intent: Verify mixed comparisons using ordered_json container values.

tests.name: test_mixed_type_swapping
tests.intent: Test multiple successive comparisons alternating left and right types.

tests.name: test_boundary_minus_one
tests.intent: Check integer values just below the exact mantissa boundary compared with floats.

tests.name: test_small_fractional_differences
tests.intent: Test integers compared with floats differing by tiny fractions.

tests.name: test_exception_safety_catch
tests.intent: Ensure comparison operations do not throw unexpected exceptions and handle types cleanly.
